title: Home work queue row
description: Normalized successful response for one domain and operating mode, after evaluation for the current viewer. A failed or suppressed provider has no row.

queueId.description: Identifier assigned to this queue within the page.

openCount.description: Count of qualifying units in the viewer's queue.

lateCount.description: Subset counted as late by this provider. Cannot exceed openCount.

warningDelayDays.description: Warning interval in days when returned by the provider. The domain defines which date starts this interval.

totalAmount.description: Monetary total for a provider which calculates one. Commercial header queues use tax-exclusive face value.
